player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Gilliatt''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in October 2001.
cards: posted: We Must Accelerate Our Plans
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(5)': Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Watto's Box, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena and Sebulba's Podracer; Start Your Engines! (the starting interrupt) is listed under Interrupts. All count toward the 60. No objective.

The description calls this a 'Type 2' deck and the strategy an 'episode 1 environment' deck (Episode I-only sets). The Coruscant-set Dark printings are used for Alter and Sense; the Dark printings for Boonta Eve Podrace and Tatooine: Podrace Arena.
The listed cards total 59, not 60: the post's 'Weapons(2)' section lists only one Maul's Lightsaber. Kept as published.
Posted 'Darth Maul, Sith Apprentice' x3 dested Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (Coruscant), the only other Episode I Maul besides Darth Maul (Tatooine, posted x2).

Posted 'TatooineDesert Landing Site' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site; 'Tatoine Podrace Arena' dested Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark); 'Orn Free Ta' dested Orn Free Taa; 'Yeb Yeb Dem'Thorn' dested Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'Toonbuch Toora' dested Toonbuck Toora; 'Podrace Collision' dested Podracer Collision; 'Theyre Still Coming Through' dested They're Still Coming Through!.
The Light Side counterpart is DeckTech 19260, posted under the same title.
Both of Raveling's posts (19260 Light, 19237 Dark) are titled "Raveling's Episode 1 Racer"; the page title adds DS to keep them apart.
dest_title: Michael Raveling Raveling's Episode 1 Racer DS
